notation: Generated DSL programs for gfx1201. Each case's `src` runs on a fresh Builder `b`, with `V` and `S` its vector and scalar files and the whole language in scope. `built` lists the Builder's own stream before any pass, one instruction per line as `<form> <operands> {fields} ; <attributes>`: a register is its VReg repr (`<file>:<value>[<group index>]x<dwords>`, `+<lo>` for a nonzero lo), a physical register its name, an immediate its value with any written spelling quoted after it (`32'0x20'`), a block `@label`, a negated or absolute source `-x` or `|x|`; fields in stored order; attributes in the fixed order comment, tag, abl, alias_ok, staged, wait_uses, in_region, places, published, lds=(region, what, field, offset none|var, ordered), m0_set, waves_taken, fence. `values` gives each value in id order as `id file name n= align=` then any `index=`, `pin=`, `same_as=`. `records` holds the lane regions, loops, deferred kinds, each file's entered/pinned/lanes-covered groups, needs, the LDS table and the wave index, when present. `error` is the class and message of a refusal while the program runs; otherwise `render` is the pipeline's final assembly lines, or `render_error` its refusal (class and the first line of its text, the program's file written kernel.py).
